text:
lauren: Quick async check — where are we on the console observability milestone that unblocks the customer-facing error insights? need owners and a rollforward plan by EOD tomorrow. :spiral_calendar:

siva: working on dash migrations (dash-views rewrite). blocker is RT-1223 (prom query cardinality spike) — cc @jamal for tracing hook rollout dependency.

jamal: tracing hook PR is queued, need a small change to how we annotate spans for rerouted requests. planning to merge after a quick perf test. estimate: 1 day.

alex: FYI the retention work (retain:90 -> retain:14 for debug traces) will drop storage by ~42% in perf env. still need confirmation from infra on read-path implications. pinging infra team now.

lauren: good — can we separate the deliverables? 1) dashboards migrated, 2) trace hooks in prod, 3) retention cutover. owners per item?

patrick: I can own the dashboards migration. I'll carve up "error-insights" into two smaller PRs: viz + query layer. will aim to land viz PR first.

maria: I'll take retention cutover (coord with infra + billing). will post a runbook and rollback steps by noon.

jamal: I'll own tracing hooks and the canary for span annotation change. plan: canary 10% traffic, check latency and sampling consistency for 2 hours, then ramp.

lauren: thanks. two lingering asks: a) add a short playbook snippet for "if error rates spike after retention change" (who paginates alerts, quick mitigations), b) trace span name mapping needs to be stable across model variants — otherwise dash graphs will be noisy.

ops-bot: New deploy window scheduled: 2026-05-14T02:00Z - 02:30Z (canary allowed).

alex: note on span names — adding a stable prefix `rwd:` to all console spans in the PR. jamal — will that break any current dashboards?

jamal: shouldn't. I updated the dash queries to use `starts_with(span_name, "rwd:")` where relevant. will add a migration step in the viz PR to backfill old spans for 7 days to avoid gaps.

lauren: action items summary — dashboards: patrick (viz PR first) // tracing hooks: jamal (canary + span prefix) // retention: maria (runbook + infra coord) // infra perf confirmation: alex. everyone please update the respective PR/issue by EOD. I'll collate for the stakeholder sync. :thumbsup:

patrick: acked — will post PR link in this thread when created.

maria: runbook draft uploaded: https://rwd.internal/s/maria/retention-cutover (comments welcome).

jamal: perf test results look clean, merging canary tonight after a short smoke. will tag in thread when canary starts. :eyes:

lauren: awesome, thanks all. if anything blocks, drop a quick note here and I'll escalate.
